decisions.statement: Nothing here takes a routing rule away or turns one off.
An address some rule already routes is left alone, whatever that rule is named.
A rule routing an address no persona declares is named rather than changed.
The address mail is forwarded on to is read back from the provider.
No page here states the address mail is forwarded on to.
The addresses to route are read off the persona pages and nowhere else.
A run over a zone nothing has changed writes nothing.
Cloudflare answers some refusals with a 200 carrying `success: false`.
A token refused the write says so rather than being tried again.

definition: the rules a mail provider carries for the addresses personas are written to
